items.title: Govt hikes petrol price by Rs5.58, HSD by Rs4.18
items.description:
The government on Tuesday increased the price of petrol by Rs5.58 per litre while increasing the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs4.18 per litre.
Following the revision, petrol will retail at Rs364.35 per litre while HSD will cost Rs385.95 per litre. The government continues to levy Rs114 per litre in taxes and duties on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel.
According to the Petroleum Division’s notification, the new prices will be applicable on Sept 9 (Wednesday).

items.description:

items.description:
Canada’s retaliatory tariffs on US goods took effect just after midnight on Tuesday as Prime Minister Mark Carney increased economic pressure on his country’s biggest trading partner after negotiations collapsed last month, intensifying an 18-month-old trade war.
